policy: Standard real-time USD API list prices with 30-minute cache writes. Long-context rates apply per request above 272,000 input tokens. No batch, fast-mode, account or regional adjustments.
scope: Selected coding agent model requests only; excludes verifier, task-internal APIs, infrastructure and unrelated runs. Recorded cache reads and writes are subsets of input. Reasoning is already included in output.

openai/gpt-6-luna.note: Standard processing. Prompts above 272,000 input tokens use long-context rates for the entire request. Cache writes use the standard automatic-cache write rate.

openai/gpt-6.1-terra.note: Standard processing with 30-minute cache writes. Above 272,000 input tokens the entire request uses 2x input/cache and 1.5x output prices.
